annotations.title: Query and change Data tables and records

description: Lists, creates, or deletes tables and lists, polls, gets, creates, batch-creates, updates, or deletes records on one Data project this account owns. Actions are list_tables, create_table, delete_table, list_records, list_changes, get_record, create_record, update_record, and delete_record. Use database for tables and records. Use files for private file bytes, export for a JSON snapshot, and project for Studio or Mobile source. list_records applies filter, search, and order to the latest 250 rows. list_changes polls rows updated after since. create_record takes one data object or a records batch of 1 to 250. Field changes stay in the Data app. This is not a websocket, Supabase Realtime, Auth, or Edge Functions.

action.description: list_tables, create_table, delete_table, list_records, list_changes, get_record, create_record, update_record, or delete_record. delete_table removes the table and its records.

columns.description: create_table fields, from 1 to 24. Names must be unique.

items.description: One table field. name and type are required. required defaults to false.

name.description: Field name: a letter, then up to 31 letters, numbers, or underscores.

required.description: When true, a record must include this field. Omitted means false.

type.description: Field type: text, number, boolean, or json.

cursor.description: list_records cursor from next_cursor. Do not combine with offset.

data.description: One record for create_record, or a field patch for update_record. Do not send data together with records.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional update_record check. Must match the record updated_at you read. A mismatch returns 409 and does not write.

filter.description: list_records column name. Send op and value with it. Empty checks omit value.

limit.description: list_records page size, from 1 to 100. Default 100.

name.description: Table name for create_table. A letter, then up to 47 letters, numbers, or underscores.

offset.description: list_records offset, from 0 to 249. Do not combine with cursor.

op.description: list_records comparison. greater-than and less-than require a number field. Boolean fields allow equals, not-equals, is-empty, and is-not-empty.

order.description: list_records sort: id, created_at, updated_at, or field:NAME. Default created_at.

projectId.description: UUID of a Data project this account owns.

q.description: list_records text search across the record id and JSON.

recordId.description: Record UUID for get_record, update_record, and delete_record.

records.description: Batch of 1 to 250 records for create_record. Do not also send data.

items.description: One record object whose fields match the table.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for list_changes. Returns rows with a later updated_at. This is a poll, not a websocket.

tableName.description: Existing table name for record actions, delete_table, and list_changes. Same shape as name.

value.description: list_records filter value. Numbers are decimal text. Booleans are true or false. Empty checks omit value.

name: database
